_note: Style-only looks for /living-painting and /style-montage, written by the studio (2026-11-23). A style says how the picture must look (medium) and how that medium may move (motion); the scene comes from a preset or the owner. Every preset in presets.json also works as a style. Method credit: the 'one scene, only the style line changes' idea follows Skale Out's public one-prompt-ten-styles page (read 2026-11-22); these descriptions are the studio's own words. engine: canvas = canvas_kit 2D painting, voxel = studio/voxel_kit.js (three.js).

pop_art.name: Pop art
pop_art.medium: A comic-print pop painting: thick black ink outlines, three or four flat primaries (cherry red, lemon yellow, cyan) and white, Ben-Day dot fields for every half-tone, one bold diagonal speed burst behind the subject, slight misregistration where a colour slips off its outline.
pop_art.motion: Shapes move as clean outlined pieces; the dot fields stay locked inside their shapes. Speed is drawn, not blurred: action lines and a jittering burst, re-drawn on twos.

voxel_3d.name: Voxel 3D
voxel_3d.medium: A world built of small cubes like a toy diorama: every object, road, rock and wave stepped out of unit voxels, a limited palette of 8 to 12 flat colours, soft sun from one side so each cube face reads as a different shade, a pale sky.
voxel_3d.motion: Objects move as whole rigid voxel groups; nothing bends smoothly. Water and smoke are cubes that pop in, rise and pop out. The camera orbits slowly around the diorama.

risograph.name: Two-colour risograph
risograph.medium: A two-ink risograph print on off-white recycled paper: fluorescent pink and teal only, overlapping into a dark violet where both inks meet, coarse grain in every flat, layers offset by a few pixels from each other, a few ink-starved patches.
risograph.motion: Each ink is its own layer moving with the object, keeping its small offset. The paper grain and the print noise stay fixed to the frame.

storybook_gouache.name: Storybook gouache
storybook_gouache.medium: A children's picture-book painting in opaque gouache and coloured pencil: soft rounded shapes, warm muted colours, pencil hatching over the paint, chalky dry-brush edges, cosy light, the paper tooth showing in the thin areas.
storybook_gouache.motion: Gentle, bouncy motion like a page come alive: soft squash and stretch, slow drifting clouds and leaves. Brush and pencil marks travel with each object; paper grain stays fixed.

xray.name: X-ray
xray.medium: A medical X-ray film: glowing cyan-white structure on deep blue-black, every object shown as its inner skeleton, frame and parts in translucent overlapping densities, a soft glow at the densest overlaps, faint scan lines and film grain.
xray.motion: Inner parts move with their objects and show their mechanics (wheels turning, joints bending). Density, not colour, carries the light. Scan noise drifts slowly and stays fixed to the frame.

candy_world.name: Candy world
candy_world.medium: Everything made of sweets: glossy hard-candy shells with a bright highlight, sugar-sprinkle textures, pastel icing ground, lollipop trees, a wafer road, marshmallow clouds; saturated pastel palette, soft subsurface glow at the edges.
candy_world.motion: Soft jelly wobble on contact and at the end of each move; sprinkles bounce and settle; glossy highlights stay where the light is while the objects move under them.

vhs_glitch.name: VHS glitch
vhs_glitch.medium: A worn home-video tape: soft low-resolution picture, colour bleeding sideways, red and blue channels split a little, horizontal tracking bands, tape noise and dropouts, crushed blacks, a warm washed-out cast. No on-screen date, logo or channel name.
vhs_glitch.motion: The scene moves normally underneath; glitches are rare and short (a tracking roll, a band tear) and land on a whole-cycle timing so the loop stays seamless.

ceramic_mosaic.name: Ceramic tile mosaic
ceramic_mosaic.medium: Glazed ceramic tiles: irregular broken pieces (larger than stone mosaic, about 30 px), each with a glossy glaze highlight and a slightly different tone, wide cream grout lines, cobalt, turquoise, terracotta and white, outlines of the forms in rows of dark tiles.
ceramic_mosaic.motion: Moving objects are their own sheets of tiles over a fixed tiled ground; tiles never bend or melt. Light slides across as a glaze glint on successive tiles.

chalkboard.name: Chalkboard
chalkboard.medium: Chalk on a dark green school board: dusty white and a few coloured chalks, side-of-chalk fills with streaky texture, smudged edges, faint ghosts of earlier erased drawings, chalk dust in the corners.
chalkboard.motion: Drawn motion: objects step between hand-drawn poses on twos; trails are quick chalk strokes that fade like a wiped smear. The board and its ghosts stay fixed.

embroidery.name: Embroidery
embroidery.medium: Hand embroidery on natural linen: satin-stitch fills whose thread direction follows each form, split-stitch outlines, French-knot dots, a few loose thread ends, the linen weave visible between stitches, soft thread sheen.
embroidery.motion: Stitched shapes move as stitched patches; stitches never stretch. Movement lines are running stitches that appear stitch by stitch. The linen stays fixed to the frame.
